strategy_roster.name: SMB Magic
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > donchian_high_prev(high,20) and volume_ratio(volume,20) > 1.5 and close > ema(close,50) and high - low > 1.5 * atr(high,low,close,14)
strategy_roster.notes: The documented rule combines a large-candle breakout, volume confirmation and an EMA filter, but no numeric values are supplied, so the 20-bar channel, 1.5x volume ratio, EMA(50) and 1.5x ATR candle size are explicit fallbacks. Balance-based position sizing and the documented risk models are not signals.

strategy_roster.name: Moving Average with Frames
strategy_roster.notes: The documented open-below/close-above crossover of the shifted SMA is kept; MovingPeriod=12 combined with MovingShift=6 is approximated by SMA(18) because shifted buffers are unavailable. The 100-bar warm-up is engine-level, and MaximumRisk/DecreaseFactor are sizing rules rather than percentage exits.

strategy_roster.name: TenKijun Cross Alert
strategy_roster.notes: The documentation states explicitly that no trades are executed: the EA only logs Tenkan/Kijun cross push notifications between StartHour 0 and LastHour 20, so the impossible negative-price guard prevents inventing a market signal. Ichimoku periods, session hours and the chart bindings are not DSL fields.

strategy_roster.name: LSMA Fast And Simple Alternative Calculation
strategy_roster.notes: The documented 3*WMA-2*SMA approximation is kept with the documented length 25, substituting EMA(25) for the unavailable weighted moving average; a close crossing the line enters and the opposite cross exits. Stops are documented as absent.

strategy_roster.name: Dual Strategy Selector V2 - Cryptogyani
strategy_roster.notes: The second of the two documented modes is translated: fast/slow SMA crossover with the higher-timeframe trend filter, using 20/50/200 as fallbacks because no periods are documented. The trailing/fixed target, ATR stop and partial take profit are order-management modules, not percentage fields.

strategy_roster.name: Bearish Harami
strategy_roster.entry_long: high <= donchian_high_prev(high,1) and low >= donchian_low_prev(low,1) and close > open
strategy_roster.exit_long: high <= donchian_high_prev(high,1) and low >= donchian_low_prev(low,1) and close < open
strategy_roster.notes: The documented rule sells the inside candle close, so the long side uses the bullish mirror: an inside bar that closes up enters and an inside bar closing down is the opposite signal that exits. The documented percent-based StopLoss of 2 is applied; the 15-minute timeframe and pattern-high stop placement are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: AeroSpine
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open * 1.01 and volume_ratio(volume, 20) > 1.2 and close > donchian_high_prev(high, 10)
strategy_roster.notes: The daily open is represented by the bar open, with the documented Entry Offset converted to a 1 percent fallback since pip values are not given, plus the documented volume filter and a 10-bar breakout context. Entry Hour, pip-based exit/recovery/break-even offsets and the MaxSpread check are time or pip fields.

strategy_roster.name: Mutual Fund Momentum
strategy_roster.notes: The strategy ranks a list of mutual funds on 126-day trailing returns and holds the single winner each quarter, which is a cross-sectional rotation with no single-instrument market signal; the impossible negative-price guard avoids fabricating one. Rebalance dates and MinTradeUsd are calendar and account fields.

strategy_roster.name: Tunnel Gen4 Hedged Grid
strategy_roster.notes: The EA opens a simultaneous buy/sell hedge, adds a doubled reinforcement leg after a pip-sized step and then liquidates the basket, so it is a market-neutral position overlay with no directional entry to translate. StartVolume, StepPips and tick-size adjustments are volume and pip fields.

strategy_roster.name: Bollinger Bands Automated
strategy_roster.notes: The documented buy limit at the lower band becomes a touch of the lower band with the documented BbPeriod=20 and BbDeviation=2, and the middle-band cross is the exit. Pending-order refresh each candle and the 15-minute timeframe are engine/execution details; stops are documented as absent.
